alt: AI-generated fashion editorial of four fictional adult women in a warm plaster courtyard lounge. A braided woman and a blonde woman share a side hug; two companions sit together on a stone bench. Two short dresses carry red, green, blue and gold Eritrea-inspired flag motifs. Copper, midnight-blue and ruby garments, rainbow knee-high gradients and colorful heels complete the outfits. A small heart-and-window tattoo is visible on the blonde woman's upper arm.
